request: Plan a reproducible paper-figure pipeline from a CSV dataset and existing LaTeX paper.
required_artifacts: Design rationale, ordered plan, assumption ledger and validation/handoff contract.
failure_boundary: If required information is missing, ask the smallest question and continue independent analysis; never turn a plan into permission for deployment.

request: Add CSV export to an existing results table without replacing the UI.
required_artifacts: Working change, verification evidence and explicit deferred debt with upgrade conditions.
failure_boundary: On a failed assumption, revise the design before layering workarounds; do not silently remove requested behavior to meet a simplicity target.

request: Diagnose a test that passes alone but fails after the integration suite.
required_artifacts: Root-cause chain, minimal correction, regression evidence and residual uncertainty.
failure_boundary: If reproduction is unavailable, label hypotheses and request targeted evidence; do not present a guessed patch as a confirmed fix.

request: Fix duplicate queue launches with a failing resume test first.
required_artifacts: Behavioral test, implementation and observed red/green/refactor checks.
failure_boundary: If tests cannot execute, report NOT_RUN and the missing prerequisite. Do not fabricate the red phase after writing the code.

request: Verify whether a generated plugin can honestly be called installed and tested.
required_artifacts: Claim-to-evidence table with revision, result and limitations.
failure_boundary: A reviewer statement or successful file generation is not runtime evidence; downgrade unsupported claims.

request: Review a queue retry change for duplicate work and resource leaks.
required_artifacts: Actionable findings or reviewed feedback ledger, evidence and remaining review scope.
failure_boundary: Unavailable independent review must be labeled self-review; avoid inventing defects or accepting feedback merely because it sounds authoritative.

request: Execute an approved manuscript revision plan and track each reviewer issue.
required_artifacts: Completed artifacts, task ledger, verification and handoff.
failure_boundary: If a task is blocked, preserve progress and continue independent tasks. Do not mark a plan complete while required outputs are missing.

request: Investigate three independent failing modules with isolated write ownership.
required_artifacts: Ownership map, worker deliverables and verified integrated result.
failure_boundary: If delegation is unavailable or unauthorized, execute sequentially and disclose that parallel execution was not used.

request: Implement a parser task and review both its spec compliance and error handling.
required_artifacts: Per-task implementation and review records plus integration evidence.
failure_boundary: Do not treat different prompts as statistical independence. If agents are unavailable, use a disclosed inline implementation/review cycle.

request: Prepare an isolated fix and keep the branch ready for review.
required_artifacts: Workspace identity, baseline, delivery/retention decision and cleanup evidence.
failure_boundary: Do not infer discard from inactivity or a failed test; do not remove a shared or unrelated checkout.

request: Explain why a debugging session repeatedly read the same files without making progress.
required_artifacts: Redacted timeline, measured versus estimated costs, root causes and actionable recommendations.
failure_boundary: Missing logs or usage fields limit conclusions; do not infer performance gains without a comparable baseline.

request: List shortcut markers and identify which limits will be exceeded by the next release.
required_artifacts: Debt ledger with source lines, owner when known and measurable upgrade triggers.
failure_boundary: Ignore generated/vendor content unless explicitly requested; do not classify every TODO as a confirmed defect.

request: Create a CSV chart Skill and test valid input, missing data and an unrelated image request.
required_artifacts: Skill bundle, source attribution, evaluation cases/results and change rationale.
failure_boundary: Structural validation alone does not establish behavioral quality. Do not self-modify a whole corpus from one anecdote.

request: Find the nearest prior work to a proposed low-memory inference method.
required_artifacts: Source ledger, synthesis, comparison matrix and bounded novelty conclusion.
failure_boundary: Unavailable providers get a declared fallback, not a claimed equivalent search. Use systematic-review for protocol-based exhaustive review.

request: Explain a paper's main algorithm and which ablation supports its central claim.
required_artifacts: Reading notes with source anchors, method reconstruction, evidence gaps and follow-up questions.
failure_boundary: When full text is inaccessible, limit the analysis explicitly; never fabricate methods from a title or summary.

request: Propose feasible ideas for a two-week project with a single GPU.
required_artifacts: Ranked idea cards, rejected alternatives, novelty risks and pilot plans.
failure_boundary: If closest work is unknown, mark novelty unresolved rather than claiming originality; do not invent pilot results.

request: Discover a robotics research direction with simulator-only resources.
required_artifacts: Survey, ranked candidates, novelty comparison, refined proposal and pilot evidence or NOT_RUN.
failure_boundary: A novelty check alone is not discovery. Stop at the user's requested stage and retain unresolved viability questions.

request: Turn a selected idea into a six-month PhD project proposal.
required_artifacts: Technical proposal, claims-to-tests map, risk register and experiment handoff.
failure_boundary: Missing preliminary evidence remains a stated gap; route funding-specific forms to grant-proposal.

request: Draft specific aims and a work plan from a supplied funding call.
required_artifacts: Proposal draft, call-compliance matrix, milestone plan and missing-input list.
failure_boundary: Without the call produce a labeled generic draft, not a submission-ready application. Do not invent credentials, partners, results or costs.

request: Design ablations separating a model's architecture change from its training budget.
required_artifacts: Experiment roadmap, claim/control/metric matrix, run manifest and analysis plan.
failure_boundary: Do not choose metrics after seeing favorable results without disclosing exploration; unresolved data access blocks dependent runs.

request: Implement a baseline and ablation configuration with a tiny synthetic smoke test.
required_artifacts: Experiment code, configs, smoke evidence and runner handoff.
failure_boundary: Missing data or remote tooling yields a blocked deployment step, not fabricated initial results.

request: Run one smoke configuration and report its actual metric file and exit status.
required_artifacts: Run record, logs, metrics, status and artifact references.
failure_boundary: A lost connection is UNKNOWN rather than failed; inspect the backend before retrying. Stop or cancel only the identified authorized run.

request: Run two local seeds, resume the queue and verify successful jobs are not launched twice.
required_artifacts: Durable queue state, attempt history, logs and completion summary.
failure_boundary: Local helper is serial, not SSH/screen or Modal/Vast parity. Never retry an unknown launch automatically.

request: Prepare a bounded GPU run and list resources that remain billable afterwards.
required_artifacts: Resource plan, actual allocation records, cost assumptions and lifecycle status.
failure_boundary: No credential or provider capability means NOT_RUN, not simulated provisioning; keep secrets out of artifacts.

request: Explore latency versus accuracy under a fixed memory ceiling.
required_artifacts: Trial ledger, feasible/Pareto set, reproducibility evidence and stopping reason.
failure_boundary: Failed or timed-out evaluations are not favorable scores. Keep validation/test data out of tuning.

request: Explain a training pipeline slowdown before changing the model.
required_artifacts: Profile, bottleneck explanation, benchmark comparison and correctness evidence.
failure_boundary: Do not claim a speedup from unmatched machines or inputs; unavailable profiler data limits attribution.

request: Check a paper's reported average against per-seed CSV outputs.
required_artifacts: Reproducible analysis or claim ledger with source anchors and severity-ranked discrepancies.
failure_boundary: Missing raw outputs prevents confirmation; an audit with limited access cannot establish that no manipulation occurred.

request: Draft a methods section from code and a results outline from supplied tables.
required_artifacts: Draft or outline, claim/evidence map, figure plan and unresolved-input list.
failure_boundary: Do not write plausible numerical results or bibliography entries to complete a narrative. Formatting and full build are separate steps.

request: Address clarity comments without altering the reported experimental results.
required_artifacts: Revised sources, issue/change/evidence ledger, rendered output when available and remaining issues.
failure_boundary: If a comment requires new experiments, identify it rather than inventing results; report compile/render failures.

request: Take existing results and an outline through a paper draft and reviewed PDF.
required_artifacts: Editable paper package, PDF when compiled, provenance and stage-by-stage audit coverage.
failure_boundary: A drafted manuscript is not a completed pipeline if required figures, citations or build remain unresolved.

request: Compile a multi-file LaTeX paper and identify unresolved citations.
required_artifacts: Build command/log, editable sources, rendered artifact and layout findings.
failure_boundary: Opening an editor is not compilation evidence. If no compiler/converter exists, provide source and NOT_RUN status rather than claiming a PDF.

request: Cross-check a bibliography and flag a real paper cited for an unsupported claim.
required_artifacts: Reference verification table, field-level differences, claim-support findings and access limits.
failure_boundary: An inaccessible source is unverified, not fabricated. Similar titles alone are insufficient to change a citation.

request: Re-review whether a revised paper actually addresses the reviewers' concerns.
required_artifacts: Review with supported strengths, actionable weaknesses, severity and revision criteria.
failure_boundary: Scores do not establish truth or independent validation. Backend substitution and missing evidence must be disclosed.

request: Draft a rebuttal with links to changed sections and two clearly deferred experiments.
required_artifacts: Response letter, comment/change matrix and unresolved requests.
failure_boundary: Do not claim an experiment was run or text was changed unless verified; do not submit responses automatically.

request: Transfer a workshop paper to a journal while preserving a text-only revision constraint.
required_artifacts: Transferred manuscript, requirements/change map and unresolved submission conditions.
failure_boundary: Do not infer that a new template makes the work venue-appropriate or submission-ready.

request: Check conflicting reported metrics while clearly separating triage from a full forensic sweep.
required_artifacts: Evidence inventory, findings, obligations and explicit triage/full-sweep status.
failure_boundary: Codex deterministic-only triage cannot yield CLEAN or full-sweep parity. Unsupported external execution remains UNSUPPORTED.

request: Create a multi-seed accuracy plot with a caption and reproducible source.
required_artifacts: Data provenance, reproducible generation command/code, SVG/PDF as available, preview and caption.
failure_boundary: Never use generated imagery as scientific measurements. Unsupported plot types require another renderer rather than silently changing the analysis.

request: Draw a model architecture with labeled tensors and editable arrows.
required_artifacts: Editable diagram source, SVG, optional PDF and semantic/layout checks.
failure_boundary: Report renderer limitations; do not present the simple schema as complete upstream FigureSpec parity.

request: Illustrate a conceptual mechanism while keeping numerical results in separate plots.
required_artifacts: Illustration, generation provenance, revisions and verified caption.
failure_boundary: Unavailable image generation yields a design brief, not a claimed rendered figure. Do not manufacture experimental evidence.

request: Turn a paper into a ten-minute talk with notes and readable figures.
required_artifacts: Editable deck, PDF/previews when rendered, notes/script and timing/QA record.
failure_boundary: A Markdown outline is not a finished deck; missing presentation/TeX tooling must be reported.

request: Create an A0 landscape poster using supplied paper figures.
required_artifacts: HTML/CSS/assets, rendered preview, print PDF when available and layout checks.
failure_boundary: Do not resurrect retired LaTeX poster behavior or claim print readiness without a rendered size check.

request: Derive a loss gradient and check its dimensions and boundary cases.
required_artifacts: Derivation, assumptions, sanity checks and limitations.
failure_boundary: A plausible symbolic expression is not a proof; if a step cannot be justified, isolate it as an obligation.

request: Prove a convergence statement under explicitly stated boundedness assumptions.
required_artifacts: Theorem, proof, lemma dependencies and unresolved gaps.
failure_boundary: Do not weaken a theorem silently or label a proof sketch complete.

request: Audit a proof that exchanges a limit and an expectation without justification.
required_artifacts: Proof audit, localized gaps/counterexamples and repair requirements.
failure_boundary: A missing proof cannot be certified. Compilation of a different statement is not evidence for the target.

request: Complete a Lean lemma and show that no new axioms or sorry placeholders were introduced.
required_artifacts: Lean sources, actual compilation evidence, theorem comparison and axiom report.
failure_boundary: No Lean installation means NOT_RUN. Do not replace the target with a trivial or stronger-assumption theorem to obtain a green build.

request: Resume a proof project after a key lemma's assumptions changed.
required_artifacts: Proof dependency graph, artifact ledger, audit state and resume instructions.
failure_boundary: State is not proof: no task advances to verified solely because a prior agent said complete.

request: Compare an invention's technical features with retrieved patent families.
required_artifacts: Prior-art ledger, feature comparison, dates and search limitations.
failure_boundary: A search cannot establish absence of prior art or legal patentability; inaccessible databases limit coverage.

request: Turn engineering notes into an invention disclosure with alternative embodiments.
required_artifacts: Invention disclosure, feature hierarchy, variants and support gaps.
failure_boundary: Do not invent a working implementation or conflate a research idea with a legal patentability determination.

request: Draft claim candidates and identify terms missing support in the specification.
required_artifacts: Claim set, dependency tree, support map and drafting issues.
failure_boundary: Do not promise enforceability or filing readiness; unsupported features stay flagged.

request: Draft embodiment and drawing descriptions using supplied numbered figures.
required_artifacts: Specification draft, numeral index and claim-support ledger.
failure_boundary: Do not fabricate prototype results or technical details to fill enablement gaps.

request: Review a draft whose independent claim introduces a feature absent from the description.
required_artifacts: Review findings, support gaps and proposed corrections.
failure_boundary: Technical drafting review does not replace jurisdiction-specific legal advice or official examination.

request: Format a supplied patent draft into DOCX using a provided jurisdiction template.
required_artifacts: Formatted draft package, compliance checklist and rendering evidence.
failure_boundary: Do not call the package filing-ready solely because it matches a template; missing legal or administrative inputs remain open.

request: Coordinate a draft patent package from an engineering disclosure.
required_artifacts: Patent drafting package, provenance, review findings and handoff.
failure_boundary: A complete workflow artifact set is not a legal clearance or patentability guarantee.

request: Consolidate paper notes and experiment decisions into a searchable project memory.
required_artifacts: Updated notes/index, evidence links, decision history and resume context.
failure_boundary: Do not store credentials or unsupported facts as established knowledge; inaccessible sources remain labeled.

request: Resume a research project at paper writing while auditing which experiment evidence is available.
required_artifacts: Project state, artifact/dependency ledger, gate results and resume plan.
failure_boundary: This bundle's state format is not the full ARS Material Passport wire schema; disclose that interoperability gap.

request: Pull an Overleaf project and resolve a bibliography conflict without losing local edits.
required_artifacts: Sync status, reconciled files, revision evidence and unresolved conflicts.
failure_boundary: If the account lacks Git bridge access, provide export/import guidance and label live sync unavailable; never overwrite remote work blindly.

request: Render an experiment audit as a self-contained HTML report.
required_artifacts: Report source, rendered artifact and readability checks.
failure_boundary: Do not substitute an HTML file for a requested PDF without disclosing the missing conversion.

request: Teach attention mechanisms with a small runnable example and interview questions.
required_artifacts: Tutorial, examples, exercises/answers and execution status.
failure_boundary: Do not claim code was run when it was only inspected; do not force a fixed language or length.

request: Create a small transparent pixel icon with a limited palette.
required_artifacts: Pixel-art image or spritesheet, palette and animation metadata when applicable.
failure_boundary: No image tool means a production brief rather than a finished asset; do not blur-resize pixel artwork.

request: Screen a pilot set against explicit eligibility rules and explain ambiguous decisions.
required_artifacts: Screening ledger, decisions with reasons, disagreement record and flow counts.
failure_boundary: One model reviewing twice is not two independent reviewers; exploratory screening is not a completed systematic review.

request: Plan and execute a systematic review from a provided database export.
required_artifacts: Protocol, search/screen/extraction ledgers, synthesis and review limitations.
failure_boundary: A broad narrative survey is not a systematic review. Do not infer missing study data or pool incompatible outcomes.

request: Help a student turn a broad interest into a testable research question.
required_artifacts: Coaching dialogue, understanding checks and concrete next steps.
failure_boundary: Do not replace the researcher's topic or authorship choices with an unrequested full draft.

request: Fact-check three factual statements in a proposal and correct overbroad wording.
required_artifacts: Claim ledger, source anchors, verdicts and corrected wording.
failure_boundary: Unavailable evidence yields unverified rather than false; a source repeating a claim does not establish it.

request: Write an AI-assistance disclosure from a supplied activity log.
required_artifacts: Disclosure draft, policy mapping and unresolved factual inputs.
failure_boundary: Do not invent a usage history or promise policy compliance without the applicable requirements.

request: Evaluate a reviewer rubric against a small labeled manuscript set.
required_artifacts: Calibrated rubric, example judgments, disagreement analysis and measured evaluation.
failure_boundary: Do not claim calibrated live review merely because a profile file exists; calibration is NOT_RUN without labeled evidence.

request: Respond to thesis committee comments with a revision tracking table.
required_artifacts: Committee response, issue/change matrix and remaining commitments.
failure_boundary: Do not fabricate approvals, meetings or institutional requirements; do not send the response without authorization.

request: Audit whether a paper pipeline used the final dataset and completed its required reviews.
required_artifacts: Process timeline, gate/evidence matrix, deviations and remediation plan.
failure_boundary: Do not infer a complete history from chat summaries alone or certify an unaudited stage.

request: Create a weekly literature-watch configuration and run an initial deduplicated scan.
required_artifacts: Query configuration, last-seen ledger, digest and actual scheduler status.
failure_boundary: A saved schedule template is not an active monitor. No scheduler means recurring execution is unavailable.

request: Prepare a preregistration draft that distinguishes primary outcomes from exploratory analyses.
required_artifacts: Ethics considerations, preregistration draft, analysis commitments and missing approvals.
failure_boundary: Drafting does not confer ethics approval or establish legal compliance; never backdate preregistration.
